# Acme

> Acme makes configurable widgets for small workshops.

Machine-readable description of the company, generated by company-framework.

## Specification

- [spec.json](spec.json): the whole company spec as JSON
- [agents/AGENTS.md](agents/AGENTS.md): company context for AI agents
- [pricing.json](pricing.json): plans and prices
- [opa/data.json](opa/data.json): data for Open Policy Agent policies

## Repositories

- [acme-example/infra](agents/acme-example/infra/AGENTS.md): DNS, repositories and CI as code.
- [acme-example/ui](agents/acme-example/ui/AGENTS.md): Shared component library.
- [acme-example/website](agents/acme-example/website/AGENTS.md): Marketing website at acme.example.
